entries.description: Continuation of a listing from the previous page. An intentional community of 3 lesbian women living and working on wooded farmland with housing, plumbing, electricity, and camping space. Ongoing projects include crop sharing, gardening, and building construction. It welcomes new members/residents, non-lesbian women, and girl children.

entries.land_location_as_stated: 25 miles NE of Palm Springs in a rural desert area
entries.description: Private 5-acre farm in a rural desert area 25 miles northeast of Palm Springs, California, lived on by two lesbian feminists (lovers of 15 years). They have permanent housing, plumbing, and electricity, raise vegetables, herbs, fruit trees, chickens, goats, and bees, and enjoy sharing skills with other lesbian women and girl children.
entries.raw_text: ARLENE & ARLINE PO Box 511, Desert Hot Springs, CA 92240 (619)329-8916. (25 miles NE of Palm Springs in a rural desert area). We are two lesbian feminists, lovers of 15 years. We have been rural wimmin for 9 years, 3 years of which on our farm. We raise our own vegetables, herbs, chickens, goats, bees, fruit trees, many flowers. We live simply and creatively (no TV) and do enjoy sharing our skills with wimmin oriented lesbians (non-racist, non-classist etc) interested in rural life. We welcome: girl children. We have/are: 2 lesbians, 5 acres, housing/permanent structures, plumbing/electricity.
entries.notes: Contact name filled with the women's names heading the listing ('ARLENE & ARLINE'). Mailing address is a PO Box; land_state is CA from '25 miles NE of Palm Springs' and mailing state. Type is Private/Individual Land under the two-woman rule ('We are two lesbian feminists, lovers of 15 years... on our farm', 'We have/are: 2 lesbians'). num_residents is 2 ('We live...', '2 lesbians'). Accepted groups: Lesbian women ('wimmin oriented lesbians'), Girl children ('We welcome: girl children'). Focuses: Farming/self-sufficiency ('on our farm. We raise our own vegetables, herbs, chickens, goats, bees, fruit trees'), Workshops/education ('enjoy sharing our skills'). Anti-racist/anti-classist statement noted ('non-racist, non-classist etc').

entries.description: A woman-owned commercial dairy, cheeseplant, and truck garden in Cool, California, with homestead animals, horses, six dwellings, a greenhouse, a pond, barns, and pasture. The owner welcomes lesbian women with farming experience to lease part of the commercial operations or buy shares in the property. No drugs allowed.
entries.raw_text: KIDS-LL-EAT IVY FARM 1220 Georgetown Rd, Cool, CA 95614 (916)823-3009. A thriving commercial dairy and cheeseplant, truck gardening, various homestead animals and horses. Six dwellings with all conveniences, spa, greenhouse, pond, barns, pasture. I welcome lesbians to lease out part of commercial operations or buy shares in the property. Requires money and responsibility. Must have country-living-animal experience and be interested, as well as believe in, ecologically run, woman owned commercial farming. NO DRUGS.
entries.notes: Land address copied from street mailing address ('1220 Georgetown Rd, Cool, CA 95614'). Type is Private/Individual Land because one woman owns it ('I welcome lesbians to lease out part of commercial operations or buy shares in the property... woman owned commercial farming') and it does not state whether she or others currently live there as a collective (though she seeks lesbians to lease/buy shares). num_residents is blank because it does not state how many people live in the six dwellings. Accepted groups: Lesbian women ('I welcome lesbians'). Focuses: Recovery/substance-free ('NO DRUGS.'), Farming/self-sufficiency ('A thriving commercial dairy and cheeseplant, truck gardening, various homestead animals and horses... commercial farming'), Environmentalism/eco-friendly ('believe in, ecologically run, woman owned commercial farming').

entries.description: A 120-acre mixed intentional community in Grand Ronde, Oregon, not exclusively women's land, with 1 lesbian woman and 5 non-lesbians (women and men) living and working on the land. They are pacifists and vegetarians practicing organic agriculture, permaculture, and communal child raising, and welcome new members/residents, lesbian women, non-lesbian women, and girl and boy children.
entries.raw_text: FOLLY FARM 9380 Hebo Rd, Grand Ronde, OR 97347 (503)879-5649. We are pacifists, vegetarians, and we practice organic agriculture, permaculture, and communal child raising. We welcome: new members/residents, girl and boy children, nonlesbian women. We have/are: 1 lesbian, 5 nonlesbians, 120 acres, housing/permanent structures, plumbing/electricity, camping space, woods, farm land, women and men living and working on the land.
entries.notes: NOT WOMEN'S LAND: Printed under 'NOTE: The following is not a women's land group, but it does welcome lesbians as visitors or members.' Land address copied from street mailing address ('9380 Hebo Rd, Grand Ronde, OR 97347'). Type is Intentional Community/Cooperative ('communal child raising. We welcome: new members/residents... 1 lesbian, 5 nonlesbians... women and men living and working on the land'). num_residents is 6 (1 lesbian + 5 nonlesbians living and working on the land). Accepted groups: Lesbian women (editor's note says 'welcome lesbians as visitors or members', plus 1 resident lesbian), Non-lesbian women ('nonlesbian women'), Girl children and Boy children ('girl and boy children'), Gay men and Non-gay men (coded as members of the land community based on '5 nonlesbians... women and men living and working on the land'). Focuses: Farming/self-sufficiency and Environmentalism/eco-friendly ('we practice organic agriculture, permaculture' presented as principles/practices of the community alongside pacifism and vegetarianism).

entries.land_location_as_stated: 10 wooded acres with 260 feet of lake frontage
entries.description: A women's campground and resort on 10 wooded acres with lake frontage in Wisconsin, owned by 1 lesbian woman with other lesbian women helping manage and plan events. It offers 3 two-bedroom housekeeping units and a campground with electric hook-ups, hot showers, and outdoor recreation, welcoming lesbian women, non-lesbian women, and girl and boy children.
entries.raw_text: WILDERNESS WAY Box 176, Wascott, WI 54890 (715)466-2635. Wilderness Way is located on 10 wooded acres with 260 feet of lake frontage. There are 3 two bedroom housekeeping units each with fully equipped kitchen and bath, and living room area. The campground includes electric hook-ups, indoor bathroom facilities with hot showers and an indoor camper lounge area. Swimming, fishing, canoeing, bicycling, hiking, horseback riding and cross country skiing. Owned by 1 lesbian. Other lesbians active in planning special events and sharing management tasks. We welcome: nonlesbian women, girl and boy children, cats and dogs.
entries.notes: Printed under 'NOTE: These groups don't have land, per se, or they aren't exactly land groups, but we included them for your information.' Per codebook, Wilderness Way is a row because it is a campground on its own 10 acres. Mailing address is a Box ('Box 176'); land_state is WI from mailing state. Type is Retreat/Gathering Space because it is a campground/vacation resort with housekeeping units and special events for visitors. num_residents is blank because 'Owned by 1 lesbian' does not explicitly state she lives there year-round. Accepted groups: Lesbian women (questionnaire directory listing, 'Owned by 1 lesbian. Other lesbians active...'), Non-lesbian women ('nonlesbian women'), Girl children and Boy children ('girl and boy children').

entries.description: A retreat and guest cabin on 2 wooded acres in the Redwoods on the Mendocino Coast, 9 miles south of Mendocino, California. It offers a private cabin for up to 3 people at $20 per night with detached shared bathroom facilities, plumbing, and electricity, welcoming lesbian women and non-lesbian women.
entries.raw_text: PEPPERLAND PO Box 464, Albion, CA 95410 (707)937-0020. We have a quiet, private cabin with detached, shared, bathroom facilities, $20 per night (up to 3 people). We are in the Redwoods on the Mendocino Coast just 9 miles south of Mendocino. We welcome: nonlesbian women. We have: 2 acres, housing/permanent structures, plumbing/electricity, woods.
entries.notes: Printed under the note 'These groups don't have land, per se, or they aren't exactly land groups...'. Extracted as a row because it holds 2 acres of rural land ('We have: 2 acres... woods'). Mailing address is a PO Box; land_state is CA from 'on the Mendocino Coast just 9 miles south of Mendocino'. Type is Retreat/Gathering Space because it is defined by offering a guest cabin for overnight visitors ('$20 per night (up to 3 people)').
